topic: How to work with the shell-bridge connections (rock1 + ubuntu boxes) effectively: Tailscale Funnel Bearer-auth bridges, /run argv-array contract, known failure signatures

subtopics.scope: The POST /run call shape: curl form, connections param for Bearer injection, command as argv array with bash -lc for compound shell, subprocess.run verbatim semantics, {stdout,stderr,returncode} response, GET /run returns 501, head/tail outputs.
seed_queries: python subprocess.run list argv no shell injection best practice
HTTP POST endpoint run bash -lc argv array JSON response stdout stderr returncode

subtopics.scope: Box profiles: ubuntu (X1E80100 laptop, 62GB, primary ARM64 Actions runner agentId 22, KVM/libvirt imaging station) and rock1 (original SBC, UART/audio, restored 2026-09-24, runner agentId 23). Internal-record subtopic, no dig.
Tailscale Funnel exposure plus a ~50 LOC stdlib Python bearer-auth bridge, the debug-with-cli pattern, and how the Sauna proxy injects the Bearer token when the connection is passed.
seed_queries: Tailscale Funnel expose local HTTPS service public hostname
minimal python http.server bearer token authentication endpoint

subtopics.scope: Read the status code first: 401 with Python http.server error page (token mismatch), 502 error code 502 (bridge process dead, origin-unreachable), 501 as auth-independent liveness control, and the direct-token test with X-Sauna-Connection-Id none.
seed_queries: tailscale funnel 502 error code 502 origin unreachable service down
http server 401 unauthorized error page token mismatch debugging

subtopics.scope: Where tokens and config live: /etc/rock1-shell.env (ROCK1_SHELL_TOKEN, same filename both boxes), /home/ubuntu/bear shared-token copy, shell-bridge-bootstrap.sh rollout script, actions-runner sidecar token files, shell-bridge.service unit names.

Field lessons: uptime is not tailnet age (13 days uptime at join), ping with a 1-byte echo alive POST before long pushes, and runner-host sweep lines (/var/run/reboot-required, apt list --upgradable).

Token hygiene risks recorded in the source doc: /home/ubuntu/bear world-readable 0644 (hardening target 0600), sidecar token files leaking into .bash_history, never printing the token, bridge running as root with ~ = /root.
seed_queries: environment file permissions 0600 secrets best practice chmod
api token leaked into bash_history cleanup prevention
